title: Command request
description: The base shape of a mutating assistant request. AgentKit defines no application identity or authorization fields; adapters derive trusted scope from their authenticated server context and may add their own extension properties.

commandId.description: Idempotency key. The same id with the same payload hash returns the recorded result; the same id with a different payload is rejected as IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

pauseEpoch.description: Correlates a resume with the pause it answers, so a stale resume cannot wake a later pause.

expectedRevision.description: Optional CAS precondition. Zero means none.
